articulation.label: March
articulation.alt: March: /m/ → /ɑ/ → /r/ → /tʃ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/tʃ/: Brief closure, then a narrow sh-like release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
